summary: Bridge-until-DPF2 non-acting routing failover. The only persistent-data change in this branch is the data-only migration 20261113010000_clear_retired_agent_pins: it NULLs AgentModelConfig.pinnedModelId / pinnedProviderId for rows whose pinned ModelProfile is retired (modelStatus = 'retired' OR retiredAt IS NOT NULL), so a stale hard pin stops aiming the router at an endpoint that no longer serves traffic and routing falls back to capability-based selection — the 'make pins soft' part of the bridge. It mutates no schema, deletes no rows, and is idempotent (pinnedModelId IS NOT NULL guard), mirroring the precedent in 20260416010000_clear_onboarding_agent_pin. Non-acting failures themselves introduce NO new persistent surface: they are counted against the exact route as a failed RouteOutcome row (toolSuccess=false with the non-acting provider error code) via recordNonActingFailure — RouteOutcome is the single source of truth and the time-decayed cost-ranking penalty derives from those rows. The whole surface is dropped at the DPF2 cutover.
affectedCopies: Single source: the primary Postgres catalog (AgentModelConfig rows). No projection, mirror, embedding, or sanitized-clone copy consumes the cleared pin columns; routing reads AgentModelConfig directly.
migration: 20261113010000_clear_retired_agent_pins — data-only UPDATE that sets AgentModelConfig.pinnedModelId / pinnedProviderId to NULL for rows whose pinned model profile is retired. No schema change, no backfill, no row deletion, re-runnable via the pinnedModelId IS NOT NULL guard.

changes.lifecycleDisposition: retain-for-agent-config-lifetime; this migration only clears stale pin columns, it adds no field and deletes no row

fields.name: pinnedModelId
fields.reason: Routing coordinate: the modelId an agent is hard-pinned to. This migration sets it to NULL only when the pinned ModelProfile is retired, so routing falls back to capability-based selection. No new information is collected; governance is inherited from the existing AgentModelConfig row.
fields.provenance: Pre-existing AgentModelConfig column, cleared in place by the data-only UPDATE when the join to ModelProfile shows the pinned model is retired. No external or new source.

fields.name: pinnedProviderId
fields.reason: Routing coordinate: the providerId half of the hard pin, cleared together with pinnedModelId because a provider pin with no model is not a meaningful route. No new information; governance inherited from the existing AgentModelConfig row.
fields.provenance: Pre-existing AgentModelConfig column, cleared in place by the data-only UPDATE alongside pinnedModelId. No external or new source.
